name: Marcus Arvan
abstract_title: Space, Time, Causation, and (AI) Consciousness: Brains are Analog Because Coherently Constructing Integrated Qualitative World-Models at the Present and Across Time Requires It
abstract: This paper argues that the existence and nature of consciousness are best explained by manifest asymmetries between space and time. I show that because the present manifests as immeasurably short in duration, to reason effectively about its environment in real-time a cognitive system must (i) construct integrated qualitative world-models, (ii) distributed across space, (iii) at every present instant, (iv) updating them accurately and coherently across time.
